sections.sectionText: Students must have an internship lined up before requesting permission for this course and must submit a report to the instructor at the end of the term. International students should request permission by completing the CPT e-form from ISSS, selecting the ASRM 398 instructor as advisor, and then emailing the instructor with 9-digit UIN and ASRM 398 request if ISSS approves the CPT. Those without a student visa may contact the instructor directly.

title: Topics in Actuarial Science
info: 1 to 4 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.

sections.sectionText: An introduction to a set of quantitative tools for risk management. Topics include dependence modeling, risk measures, aggregate loss models, extreme value theory, as well as some other advanced topics in emerging risks and technologies if time permits. Prerequisite: ASRM 401/STAT 408 or STAT 400 or MATH 461. This section is not intended for graduate students. Graduate students in the Actuarial Science Program interested in this course should enroll in ASRM 595 GQR.
